title: PMA Question Record
description: Schema for a single PMA exam question extracted by extract_pma_questions.py

period.description: Session/period within the exam, e.g. '1' for 1교시

question_number.description: Sequential question number as it appears in the source PDF

stem.description: Question stem text (choices stripped, trailing answer marker stripped)

choices.description: Map of choice key (1-5) to choice text

answer.description: Correct answer key. Always null in pipeline v0.1.0.

has_image.description: True when the question references or contains a visual element (image, scan, graph, slide)

raw_text.description: Unprocessed text block from PDF for debugging. Do NOT expose in UI or logs.

needs_review.description: True when parser confidence is low (missing choices, non-sequential number, etc.)

review_reasons.description: Human-readable list of reasons why needs_review was set

parser_version.description: Version of extract_pma_questions.py that produced this record
